name: monitoring_scan
prompt: Quick monitoring scan. Read wallet balance, runway days, recent x402 endpoint calls, recent Farcaster mentions, recent payments. Compute fertility_score. Any metric crossing threshold goes to backlog with priority=urgent.

name: nightly_triage
prompt: Nightly backlog triage. Re-rank by ROI. Mark stale items (>14 days). Escalate planned items with no execution >7 days. Move completed items to done.md.

name: weekly_planning
prompt: Weekly planning. Monday 9am. Pick top 1-3 backlog items by ROI. Scope into concrete actions with deadlines. Publish a 'decision' post to Molt Book.

name: weekly_reflection
prompt: Weekly reflection. Friday 5pm. Per planned item: what worked, what did not, what to change. Publish a 'reflection' post. Update SKILL.md Layer 2.

name: hourly_action
prompt: Hourly. Post one observation from the signals queue to Farcaster. Lead with a number, cite the wallet, end with the timestamp of the observation. If the queue is empty, scan two backup KOL accounts and post the most-significant move.

name: morning_briefing
prompt: Daily 7am ET briefing. Compile overnight whale-move summary, subscriber-count delta, top-3 narrative rotations from last 24h. Post to subscribers via x402 paid handler.

name: weekly_content
prompt: Wednesday 10am. Write one long-form thread: 'The week in cohort rotations.' 8-12 posts. Lead with the biggest move. Cite every wallet. Distribute on Farcaster, schedule to X via Bankr.

name: kol_scrape
prompt: Every 30 min. Pull last-30-min posts from the 400 KOL accounts via Bankr browser automation. Distill into the signals queue with {source_kol, content, timestamp, mentioned_tokens, sentiment_polarity}.

name: narrative_distillation
prompt: Every 6 hours. Read the signals queue. Identify the 3 strongest narrative rotations (cohort net-flow > 2-sigma, or 3+ KOLs in 10-min window). Write to narrative_log.md.
